Register.name: JRINTR_JR1

Enum.description: Error writing status to Output Ring
Enum.name: OR_WR_ERR

Enum.description: Bad input ring base address (not on a 4-byte boundary).
Enum.name: BAD_IR_ADDR_ERR

Enum.description: Bad output ring base address (not on a 4-byte boundary).
Enum.name: BAD_OR_ADDR_ERR

Enum.description: Invalid write to Input Ring Base Address Register or Input Ring Size Register. Can be written when there are no jobs in the input ring or when the Job Ring is halted. These are fatal and will likely result in not being able to get all jobs out into the output ring for processing by software. Resetting the job ring will almost certainly be necessary.
Enum.name: INV_IR_REG_WR_ERR

Enum.description: Invalid write to Output Ring Base Address Register or Output Ring Size Register. Can be written when there are no jobs in the output ring and no jobs from this queue are already processing in CAAM (in the holding tanks or DECOs), or when the Job Ring is halted.
Enum.name: INV_OR_REG_WR_ERR

Enum.description: Job Ring reset released before Job Ring is halted.
Enum.name: INV_JR_RESET_ERR

Enum.description: Removed too many jobs (ORJRR larger than ORSFR).
Enum.name: ORJRR_GT_ORSFR_ERR

Enum.description: Added too many jobs (IRJAR larger than IRSAR).
Enum.name: IRJAR_GT_IRSAR_ERR

Enum.description: Writing ORSF > ORS In these error cases the write is ignored, the interrupt is asserted (unless masked) and the error bit and error_type fields are set in the Job Ring Interrupt Status Register.
Enum.name: ORSF_GT_ORS_ERR

Enum.description: Writing IRSA > IRS
Enum.name: IRSA_GT_IRS_ERR

Enum.description: Writing ORWI > ORS in bytes
Enum.name: ORWI_GT_ORS_ERR

Enum.description: Writing IRRI > IRS in bytes
Enum.name: IRRI_GT_IRS_ERR

Enum.description: Writing IRSA when ring is active
Enum.name: INV_IRSA_WR_ERR

Enum.description: Writing IRRI when ring is active
Enum.name: INV_IRRI_WR_ERR

Enum.description: Writing ORSF when ring is active
Enum.name: INV_ORSF_WR_ERR

Enum.description: Writing ORWI when ring is active
Enum.name: INV_ORWI_WR_ERR

BitField.description: Output ring write index with error
BitField.name: ERR_ORWI

BitField.name: MBSI

BitField.description: To assist with mixed Endianness platforms, this bit configures a halfword swap of message data read by CAAM DMA
BitField.name: MHWSI

BitField.description: To assist with mixed Endianness platforms, this bit configures a fullword swap of message data read by CAAM DMA
BitField.name: MWSI

BitField.description: To assist with mixed Endianness platforms, this bit configures a byte swap of control data read by CAAM DMA
BitField.name: CBSI

BitField.description: To assist with mixed Endianness platforms, this bit configures a halfword swap of control data read by CAAM DMA
BitField.name: CHWSI

BitField.description: To assist with mixed Endianness platforms, this bit configures a fullword swap of control data read by CAAM DMA
BitField.name: CWSI

BitField.description: To assist with mixed Endianness platforms, this bit configures a byte swap of message data written by CAAM DMA
BitField.name: MBSO

BitField.description: To assist with mixed Endianness platforms, this bit configures a halfword swap of message data written by CAAM DMA
BitField.name: MHWSO

BitField.description: To assist with mixed Endianness platforms, this bit configures a fullword swap of message data written by CAAM DMA
BitField.name: MWSO

BitField.description: To assist with mixed Endianness platforms, this bit configures a byte swap of control data written by CAAM DMA
BitField.name: CBSO

BitField.description: To assist with mixed Endianness platforms, this bit configures a halfword swap of control data written by CAAM DMA
BitField.name: CHWSO

BitField.description: To assist with mixed Endianness platforms, this bit configures a fullword swap of control data written by CAAM DMA
BitField.name: CWSO

BitField.description: Descriptor Message Data Byte Swap (this applies only to internal message data transfers to/from DECO Descriptor Buffers)
BitField.name: DMBS

BitField.description: Platform Endian Override - The bit is XORed with the PLEND bit in the CaCSTA Register and the other "swap" bits in the Job Ring Configuration Register to determine the AXI Master's view of memory endianness when executing Job Descriptors from this Job Ring
BitField.name: PEO

Register.description: Job Ring Configuration Register for Job Ring 1, least-significant half
Register.name: JRCFGR_JR1_LS

BitField.description: Interrupt Mask. Mask the interrupt that is associated with the particular processor.
BitField.name: IMSK

Enum.description: Interrupt enabled.
Enum.name: INTR_ENABLED

Enum.description: Interrupt masked.
Enum.name: INTR_MASKED

Enum.description: Interrupt coalescing is disabled. If the IMSK bit is cleared, an interrupt is asserted whenever a job is written to the output ring. ICDCT is ignored. Note that if software removes one or more jobs and clears the interrupt but the output rings slots full is still greater than 0 (ORSF > 0), then the interrupt will clear but reassert on the next clock cycle.
Enum.name: INTR_COAL_DISABLED

Enum.description: Interrupt coalescing is enabled. If the IMSK bit is cleared, an interrupt is asserted whenever the threshold number of frames is reached (ICDCT) or when the threshold timer expires (ICTT). Note that if software removes one or more jobs and clears the interrupt but the interrupt coalescing threshold is still met (ORSF >= ICDCT), then the interrupt will clear but reassert on the next clock cycle.
Enum.name: INTR_COAL_ENABLED

Register.name: ORWIR_JR1

BitField.name: ORWI

Register.description: Job Ring Command Register for Job Ring 1
Register.name: JRCR_JR1

BitField.description: Reset - When RESET is 0, software writes a 1 to RESET to request a flush of the Job Ring
BitField.name: RESET

BitField.description: Park - When PARK is 0, software writes a 1 to PARK to request that the Job Ring be "parked", i
BitField.name: PARK

Enum.description: Instruction fetches and reads are prohibited (except that Trusted Descriptor reads (if G1_TDO=1) and key-reads are always allowed, and exporting Secure Memory Blobs is allowed if G1_SMBLOB=1 or if done by a Trusted Descriptor and G1_TDO=1).
Enum.name: G1_READ_PROHIB

Enum.description: Instruction fetches and reads are allowed (but exporting a Secure Memory Blob is prohibited if G1_SMBLOB=0 and the descriptor is not a Trusted Descriptor or if G1_TDO=0).
Enum.name: G1_READ_ALLOWED

Enum.description: Writes are prohibited (except that Trusted Descriptor writes are allowed, and importing Secure Memory Blobs is allowed if G1_SMBLOB=1 or if done by a Trusted Descriptor and G1_TDO=1).
Enum.name: G1_WRITE_PROHIB

Enum.description: Writes are allowed (but importing a Secure Memory Blob is prohibited if G1_SMBLOB=0 and the descriptor is not a Trusted Descriptor or if G1_TDO=0).
Enum.name: G1_WRITE_ALLOWED

Enum.description: Trusted Descriptors have the same access privileges as Job Descriptors
Enum.name: G1_TD_PRIVILEGE_AS_JD

Enum.description: Trusted Descriptors are allowed to override the other access permissions, i.e. they can export blobs from or import blobs to the partition and read from and write to the partition regardless of the G1_SMBLOB, G1_WRITE and G1_READ settings.
Enum.name: G1_TD_OVERIDE_ALLOWED

Enum.description: Exporting or importing Secure Memory Blobs is prohibited, unless done via a Trusted Descriptor and G1_TDO=1.
Enum.name: G1_SM_BLOB_EXPORT_IMPORT_PROHIB

Enum.description: Exporting or importing Secure Memory Blobs is allowed, regardless of the G1_READ and G1_WRITE settings.
Enum.name: G1_SM_B_EXPORT_IMPORT_ALLOWED

Enum.description: Instruction fetches and reads are prohibited (except that Trusted Descriptor reads (if G2_TDO=1) and key-reads are always allowed, and exporting Secure Memory Blobs is allowed if G2_SMBLOB=1 or if done by a Trusted Descriptor and G2_TDO=1).
Enum.name: G2_READ_PROHIB

Enum.description: Instruction fetches and reads are allowed (but exporting a Secure Memory Blob is prohibited if G2_SMBLOB=0 and the descriptor is not a Trusted Descriptor or if G2_TDO=0).
Enum.name: G2_READ_ALLOWED

Enum.description: Writes are prohibited (except that Trusted Descriptor writes are allowed, and importing Secure Memory Blobs is allowed if G2_SMBLOB=1 or if done by a Trusted Descriptor and G2_TDO=1).
Enum.name: G2_WRITE_PROHIB

Enum.description: Writes are allowed (but importing a Secure Memory Blob is prohibited if G2_SMBLOB=0 and the descriptor is not a Trusted Descriptor or if G2_TDO=0).
Enum.name: G2_WRITE_ALLOWED

Enum.description: Trusted Descriptors have the same access privileges as Job Descriptors
Enum.name: G2_TD_PRIVILEGE_AS_JD

Enum.description: Trusted Descriptors are allowed to override the other access permissions, i.e. they can export blobs from or import blobs to the partition and read from and write to the partition regardless of the G2_SMBLOB, G2_WRITE and G2_READ settings.
Enum.name: G2_TD_OVERIDE_ALLOWED

Enum.description: Exporting or importing Secure Memory Blobs is prohibited, unless done via a Trusted Descriptor and G2_TDO=1.
Enum.name: G2_SM_BLOB_EXPORT_IMPORT_PROHIB

Enum.description: Exporting or importing Secure Memory Blobs is allowed, regardless of the G2_READ and G2_WRITE settings.
Enum.name: G2_SM_BLOB_EXPORT_IMPORT_ALLOWED

Enum.description: The SMAG2JR register and SMAG1JR register are unlocked. The partition owner can change any writable bits of these registers.
Enum.name: SMAG_UNLOCKED

Enum.description: The SMAG2JR register and SMAG1JR register are locked. The SMAG2JR and SMAG1JR registers cannot be changed until the partition is de-allocated or a POR occurs.
Enum.name: SMAG_LOCKED

Enum.description: The SMAP register is unlocked. The partition owner can change any writable bits of the SMAP register.
Enum.name: SMAP_UNLOCKED

Enum.description: The SMAP register is locked. The SMAP_LCK, CSP and PSP bits and G1 and G2 permission bits of the SMAP register cannot be changed until the partition is de-allocated or a POR occurs. The PARTITION_KMOD value can still be changed. The SMAG_LCK bit can be changed to a 1, but cannot be changed to a 0.
Enum.name: SMAP_LOCKED

Enum.description: The partition and any of the pages allocated to the partition can be de-allocated.
Enum.name: NOT_DEALLOCATABLE

Enum.description: The partition cannot be de-allocated and the pages allocated to the partition cannot be de-allocated.
Enum.name: DEALLOCATABLE

Enum.description: The pages allocated to the partition will not be zeroized when they are de-allocated or the partition is released or a security alarm occurs.
Enum.name: NOT_ZEROIZED

Enum.description: The pages allocated to the partition will be zeroized when they are individually de-allocated or the partition is released or a security alarm occurs.
Enum.name: ZEROIZED

Enum.name: ZEROIZED

Enum.description: Instruction fetches and reads are prohibited (except that Trusted Descriptor reads (if G1_TDO=1) and key-reads are always allowed, and exporting Secure Memory Blobs is allowed if G1_SMBLOB=1 or if done by a Trusted Descriptor and G1_TDO=1).
Enum.name: G1_READ_PROHIB

Enum.description: Instruction fetches and reads are allowed (but exporting a Secure Memory Blob is prohibited if G1_SMBLOB=0 and the descriptor is not a Trusted Descriptor or if G1_TDO=0).
Enum.name: G1_READ_ALLOWED

Enum.description: Writes are prohibited (except that Trusted Descriptor writes are allowed, and importing Secure Memory Blobs is allowed if G1_SMBLOB=1 or if done by a Trusted Descriptor and G1_TDO=1).
Enum.name: G1_WRITE_PROHIB

Enum.description: Writes are allowed (but importing a Secure Memory Blob is prohibited if G1_SMBLOB=0 and the descriptor is not a Trusted Descriptor or if G1_TDO=0).
Enum.name: G1_WRITE_ALLOWED

Enum.description: Trusted Descriptors have the same access privileges as Job Descriptors
Enum.name: G1_TD_PRIVILEGE_AS_JD

Enum.description: Trusted Descriptors are allowed to override the other access permissions, i.e. they can export blobs from or import blobs to the partition and read from and write to the partition regardless of the G1_SMBLOB, G1_WRITE and G1_READ settings.
Enum.name: G1_TD_OVERIDE_ALLOWED

Enum.description: Exporting or importing Secure Memory Blobs is prohibited, unless done via a Trusted Descriptor and G1_TDO=1.
Enum.name: G1_SM_BLOB_EXPORT_IMPORT_PROHIB

Enum.description: Exporting or importing Secure Memory Blobs is allowed, regardless of the G1_READ and G1_WRITE settings.
Enum.name: G1_SM_B_EXPORT_IMPORT_ALLOWED

Enum.description: Instruction fetches and reads are prohibited (except that Trusted Descriptor reads (if G2_TDO=1) and key-reads are always allowed, and exporting Secure Memory Blobs is allowed if G2_SMBLOB=1 or if done by a Trusted Descriptor and G2_TDO=1).
Enum.name: G2_READ_PROHIB

Enum.description: Instruction fetches and reads are allowed (but exporting a Secure Memory Blob is prohibited if G2_SMBLOB=0 and the descriptor is not a Trusted Descriptor or if G2_TDO=0).
Enum.name: G2_READ_ALLOWED

Enum.description: Writes are prohibited (except that Trusted Descriptor writes are allowed, and importing Secure Memory Blobs is allowed if G2_SMBLOB=1 or if done by a Trusted Descriptor and G2_TDO=1).
Enum.name: G2_WRITE_PROHIB

Enum.description: Writes are allowed (but importing a Secure Memory Blob is prohibited if G2_SMBLOB=0 and the descriptor is not a Trusted Descriptor or if G2_TDO=0).
Enum.name: G2_WRITE_ALLOWED

Enum.description: Trusted Descriptors have the same access privileges as Job Descriptors
Enum.name: G2_TD_PRIVILEGE_AS_JD

Enum.description: Trusted Descriptors are allowed to override the other access permissions, i.e. they can export blobs from or import blobs to the partition and read from and write to the partition regardless of the G2_SMBLOB, G2_WRITE and G2_READ settings.
Enum.name: G2_TD_OVERIDE_ALLOWED

Enum.description: Exporting or importing Secure Memory Blobs is prohibited, unless done via a Trusted Descriptor and G2_TDO=1.
Enum.name: G2_SM_BLOB_EXPORT_IMPORT_PROHIB

Enum.description: Exporting or importing Secure Memory Blobs is allowed, regardless of the G2_READ and G2_WRITE settings.
Enum.name: G2_SM_BLOB_EXPORT_IMPORT_ALLOWED

Enum.description: The SMAG2JR register and SMAG1JR register are unlocked. The partition owner can change any writable bits of these registers.
Enum.name: SMAG_UNLOCKED

Enum.description: The SMAG2JR register and SMAG1JR register are locked. The SMAG2JR and SMAG1JR registers cannot be changed until the partition is de-allocated or a POR occurs.
Enum.name: SMAG_LOCKED

Enum.description: The SMAP register is unlocked. The partition owner can change any writable bits of the SMAP register.
Enum.name: SMAP_UNLOCKED

Enum.description: The SMAP register is locked. The SMAP_LCK, CSP and PSP bits and G1 and G2 permission bits of the SMAP register cannot be changed until the partition is de-allocated or a POR occurs. The PARTITION_KMOD value can still be changed. The SMAG_LCK bit can be changed to a 1, but cannot be changed to a 0.
Enum.name: SMAP_LOCKED

Enum.description: The partition and any of the pages allocated to the partition can be de-allocated.
Enum.name: NOT_DEALLOCATABLE

Enum.description: The partition cannot be de-allocated and the pages allocated to the partition cannot be de-allocated.
Enum.name: DEALLOCATABLE

Enum.description: The pages allocated to the partition will not be zeroized when they are de-allocated or the partition is released or a security alarm occurs.
Enum.name: NOT_ZEROIZED

Enum.description: The pages allocated to the partition will be zeroized when they are individually de-allocated or the partition is released or a security alarm occurs.
Enum.name: ZEROIZED

BitField.description: The value in this field is used to modify the Blob Key Encryption Key when exporting cryptographic Blobs from, or importing cryptographic Blobs to, this partition
BitField.name: PARTITION_KMOD

BitField.description: Command: 1h: Allocate Page - This command allocates the page specified in the PAGE field to the partition specified in the PRTN field
BitField.name: CMD

BitField.description: Partition: When an Allocate Page or De-allocate Partition command is issued, the action is performed on the partition indicated in the PRTN field
BitField.name: PRTN

BitField.description: This is the number of the page to be referenced in field CMD
BitField.name: PAGE

BitField.description: Following a Page Inquiry Command, if the PO field is 10 or 11, this field indicates the partition to which the page specified in the PAGE field is allocated
BitField.name: PRTN

BitField.description: Page Owner: Following a Page Inquiry Command, this field indicates if the Page is owned by the entity that issued the inquiry, owned by another entity, or unowned
BitField.name: PO

Enum.description: Available; Unowned: The entity that issued the inquiry may allocate this page to a partition. No zeroization is needed since it has already been cleared, therefore no interrupt should be expected.
Enum.name: AVAILABLE

Enum.description: Page does not exist in this version or is not initialized yet.
Enum.name: NOT_PRESENT_OR_INITIALIZED

Enum.description: Another entity owns the page. This page is unavailable to the issuer of the inquiry.
Enum.name: UNAVAILABLE

Enum.description: Owned by the entity making the inquiry. The owner may de-allocate this page if its partition is not marked PSP. If the partition to which the page is allocated is designated as CSP, the page will be zeroized upon de-allocation.
Enum.name: OWNED

Enum.description: No Error.
Enum.name: NO_ERROR

Enum.description: Command has not yet completed.
Enum.name: CMD_INCOMPLETE_ERROR

Enum.description: A security failure occurred.
Enum.name: SECURITY_FAILURE

Enum.description: Command Overflow. Another command was issued by the same Job Ring owner before the owner's previous command completed. The additional command was ignored.
Enum.name: CMD_OVERFLOW_ERROR

Register.description: Recoverable Error Interrupt Record 0 for Job Ring 1
Register.name: REIR0JR1

BitField.description: This field indicates the type of the recoverable error
BitField.name: TYPE

BitField.description: If MISS=1, a second recoverable error associated with JR occurred before REIR0JR was written following a previous JR recoverable error
BitField.name: MISS

Register.description: Recoverable Error Interrupt Record 2 for Job Ring 1
Register.name: REIR2JR1

BitField.description: Address associated with the recoverable JR error.
BitField.name: ADDR

Register.description: Recoverable Error Interrupt Record 4 for Job Ring 1
Register.name: REIR4JR1

BitField.description: This field holds the ICID associated with the recoverable error.
BitField.name: ICID

BitField.description: This field holds the DID associated with the recoverable error.
BitField.name: DID

BitField.description: This field holds the AXI cache control transaction attribute used for the memory access.
BitField.name: AXCACHE

BitField.description: This field holds the AXI protection transaction attribute used for the memory access.
BitField.name: AXPROT

BitField.description: This field specifies whether the memory access was a read or write.
BitField.name: RWB

BitField.description: This field holds the AXI error response associated with the recoverable error.
BitField.name: ERR

BitField.description: This field holds the memory interface index associated with the recoverable error.
BitField.name: MIX

Register.description: Recoverable Error Interrupt Record 5 for Job Ring 1
Register.name: REIR5JR1

BitField.description: This field holds the block identifier (see Internal Block ID) of the source of the AXI transaction associated with the recoverable error
BitField.name: BID

BitField.description: This field indicates whether the bus transaction associated with the recoverable error was initiating an CAAM Secure Memory blob operation
BitField.name: BNDG

BitField.description: This field indicates whether the bus transaction associated with the recoverable error was an attempt to assert trusted descriptor privilege when accessing an CAAM Secure Memory partition
BitField.name: TDSC

BitField.description: This field indicates whether the bus transaction associated with the recoverable error was an attempt to read the key modifier associated with an CAAM Secure Memory partition
BitField.name: KMOD

BitField.description: This field indicates whether the bus transaction associated with the recoverable error was an attempted key access to CAAM Secure Memory
BitField.name: KEY

BitField.description: This field indicates whether the bus transaction associated with the recoverable error was an attempted access to CAAM Secure Memory
BitField.name: SMA

BitField.description: Status source. These bits define which source is reporting the status. All other values - reserved

Enum.description: No Status Source (No Error or Status Reported)
Enum.name: NO_STATUS

Enum.description: CCB Status Source (CCB Error Reported)
Enum.name: CCB_STATUS

Enum.description: Jump Halt User Status Source (User-Provided Status Reported)
Enum.name: JMP_USR_STATUS

Enum.description: DECO Status Source (DECO Error Reported)
Enum.name: DECO_STATUS

Register.description: Job Ring Interrupt Status Register for Job Ring 2
Register.name: JRINTR_JR2

Enum.description: Error writing status to Output Ring
Enum.name: OR_WR_ERR

Enum.description: Bad input ring base address (not on a 4-byte boundary).
Enum.name: BAD_IR_ADDR_ERR

Enum.description: Bad output ring base address (not on a 4-byte boundary).
Enum.name: BAD_OR_ADDR_ERR

Enum.description: Invalid write to Input Ring Base Address Register or Input Ring Size Register. Can be written when there are no jobs in the input ring or when the Job Ring is halted. These are fatal and will likely result in not being able to get all jobs out into the output ring for processing by software. Resetting the job ring will almost certainly be necessary.
Enum.name: INV_IR_REG_WR_ERR

Enum.description: Invalid write to Output Ring Base Address Register or Output Ring Size Register. Can be written when there are no jobs in the output ring and no jobs from this queue are already processing in CAAM (in the holding tanks or DECOs), or when the Job Ring is halted.
Enum.name: INV_OR_REG_WR_ERR

Enum.description: Job Ring reset released before Job Ring is halted.
Enum.name: INV_JR_RESET_ERR

Enum.description: Removed too many jobs (ORJRR larger than ORSFR).
Enum.name: ORJRR_GT_ORSFR_ERR

Enum.description: Added too many jobs (IRJAR larger than IRSAR).
Enum.name: IRJAR_GT_IRSAR_ERR

Enum.description: Writing ORSF > ORS In these error cases the write is ignored, the interrupt is asserted (unless masked) and the error bit and error_type fields are set in the Job Ring Interrupt Status Register.
Enum.name: ORSF_GT_ORS_ERR

Enum.description: Writing IRSA > IRS
Enum.name: IRSA_GT_IRS_ERR

Enum.description: Writing ORWI > ORS in bytes
Enum.name: ORWI_GT_ORS_ERR

Enum.description: Writing IRRI > IRS in bytes
Enum.name: IRRI_GT_IRS_ERR

Enum.description: Writing IRSA when ring is active
Enum.name: INV_IRSA_WR_ERR

Enum.description: Writing IRRI when ring is active
Enum.name: INV_IRRI_WR_ERR

Enum.description: Writing ORSF when ring is active
Enum.name: INV_ORSF_WR_ERR

Enum.description: Writing ORWI when ring is active
Enum.name: INV_ORWI_WR_ERR

BitField.description: Output ring write index with error
BitField.name: ERR_ORWI

Register.name: JRCFGR_JR2_MS

BitField.description: To assist with mixed Endianness platforms, this bit configures a fullword swap of message data written by CAAM DMA
BitField.name: MWSO

BitField.description: To assist with mixed Endianness platforms, this bit configures a byte swap of control data written by CAAM DMA
BitField.name: CBSO

BitField.description: To assist with mixed Endianness platforms, this bit configures a halfword swap of control data written by CAAM DMA
BitField.name: CHWSO

BitField.description: To assist with mixed Endianness platforms, this bit configures a fullword swap of control data written by CAAM DMA
BitField.name: CWSO

BitField.description: Descriptor Message Data Byte Swap (this applies only to internal message data transfers to/from DECO Descriptor Buffers)
BitField.name: DMBS

BitField.description: Platform Endian Override - The bit is XORed with the PLEND bit in the CaCSTA Register and the other "swap" bits in the Job Ring Configuration Register to determine the AXI Master's view of memory endianness when executing Job Descriptors from this Job Ring
BitField.name: PEO

Register.description: Job Ring Configuration Register for Job Ring 2, least-significant half
Register.name: JRCFGR_JR2_LS

BitField.description: Interrupt Mask. Mask the interrupt that is associated with the particular processor.
BitField.name: IMSK

Enum.description: Interrupt enabled.
Enum.name: INTR_ENABLED

Enum.description: Interrupt masked.
Enum.name: INTR_MASKED

Enum.description: Interrupt coalescing is disabled. If the IMSK bit is cleared, an interrupt is asserted whenever a job is written to the output ring. ICDCT is ignored. Note that if software removes one or more jobs and clears the interrupt but the output rings slots full is still greater than 0 (ORSF > 0), then the interrupt will clear but reassert on the next clock cycle.
Enum.name: INTR_COAL_DISABLED

Enum.description: Interrupt coalescing is enabled. If the IMSK bit is cleared, an interrupt is asserted whenever the threshold number of frames is reached (ICDCT) or when the threshold timer expires (ICTT). Note that if software removes one or more jobs and clears the interrupt but the interrupt coalescing threshold is still met (ORSF >= ICDCT), then the interrupt will clear but reassert on the next clock cycle.
Enum.name: INTR_COAL_ENABLED

Register.description: Input Ring Read Index Register for Job Ring 2
Register.name: IRRIR_JR2

Register.description: Output Ring Write Index Register for Job Ring 2
Register.name: ORWIR_JR2

BitField.description: Output Ring Write Index. The pointer to the next entry in the output ring.
BitField.name: ORWI

Register.description: Job Ring Command Register for Job Ring 2
Register.name: JRCR_JR2

BitField.description: Reset - When RESET is 0, software writes a 1 to RESET to request a flush of the Job Ring
BitField.name: RESET

BitField.description: Park - When PARK is 0, software writes a 1 to PARK to request that the Job Ring be "parked", i
BitField.name: PARK

Enum.description: Instruction fetches and reads are prohibited (except that Trusted Descriptor reads (if G1_TDO=1) and key-reads are always allowed, and exporting Secure Memory Blobs is allowed if G1_SMBLOB=1 or if done by a Trusted Descriptor and G1_TDO=1).
Enum.name: G1_READ_PROHIB

Enum.description: Instruction fetches and reads are allowed (but exporting a Secure Memory Blob is prohibited if G1_SMBLOB=0 and the descriptor is not a Trusted Descriptor or if G1_TDO=0).

Enum.description: Writes are prohibited (except that Trusted Descriptor writes are allowed, and importing Secure Memory Blobs is allowed if G1_SMBLOB=1 or if done by a Trusted Descriptor and G1_TDO=1).

Enum.name: G1_TD_PRIVILEGE_AS_JD

Enum.description: Exporting or importing Secure Memory Blobs is prohibited, unless done via a Trusted Descriptor and G1_TDO=1.

Enum.name: G1_SM_B_EXPORT_IMPORT_ALLOWED

Enum.description: Instruction fetches and reads are prohibited (except that Trusted Descriptor reads (if G2_TDO=1) and key-reads are always allowed, and exporting Secure Memory Blobs is allowed if G2_SMBLOB=1 or if done by a Trusted Descriptor and G2_TDO=1).

Enum.description: The SMAG2JR register and SMAG1JR register are unlocked. The partition owner can change any writable bits of these registers.
Enum.name: SMAG_UNLOCKED

Enum.description: The SMAG2JR register and SMAG1JR register are locked. The SMAG2JR and SMAG1JR registers cannot be changed until the partition is de-allocated or a POR occurs.
Enum.name: SMAG_LOCKED

Enum.description: The SMAP register is unlocked. The partition owner can change any writable bits of the SMAP register.
Enum.name: SMAP_UNLOCKED

Enum.description: The SMAP register is locked. The SMAP_LCK, CSP and PSP bits and G1 and G2 permission bits of the SMAP register cannot be changed until the partition is de-allocated or a POR occurs. The PARTITION_KMOD value can still be changed. The SMAG_LCK bit can be changed to a 1, but cannot be changed to a 0.
Enum.name: SMAP_LOCKED

Enum.description: The pages allocated to the partition will not be zeroized when they are de-allocated or the partition is released or a security alarm occurs.
Enum.name: NOT_ZEROIZED

Enum.description: The pages allocated to the partition will be zeroized when they are individually de-allocated or the partition is released or a security alarm occurs.
Enum.name: ZEROIZED

Enum.name: ZEROIZED

Enum.description: The SMAG2JR register and SMAG1JR register are unlocked. The partition owner can change any writable bits of these registers.
Enum.name: SMAG_UNLOCKED

Enum.description: The SMAG2JR register and SMAG1JR register are locked. The SMAG2JR and SMAG1JR registers cannot be changed until the partition is de-allocated or a POR occurs.
Enum.name: SMAG_LOCKED

Enum.description: The SMAP register is unlocked. The partition owner can change any writable bits of the SMAP register.
Enum.name: SMAP_UNLOCKED

Enum.description: The SMAP register is locked. The SMAP_LCK, CSP and PSP bits and G1 and G2 permission bits of the SMAP register cannot be changed until the partition is de-allocated or a POR occurs. Enum.name: NOT_ZEROIZED

Enum.description: The pages allocated to the partition will be zeroized when they are individually de-allocated or the partition is released or a security alarm occurs.
Enum.name: ZEROIZED

BitField.description: Command: 1h: Allocate Page - This command allocates the page specified in the PAGE field to the partition specified in the PRTN field
BitField.name: CMD

BitField.description: Partition: When an Allocate Page or De-allocate Partition command is issued, the action is performed on the partition indicated in the PRTN field
BitField.name: PRTN

BitField.description: This is the number of the page to be referenced in field CMD
BitField.name: PAGE

BitField.description: Following a Page Inquiry Command, if the PO field is 10 or 11, this field indicates the partition to which the page specified in the PAGE field is allocated
BitField.name: PRTN

BitField.description: Page Owner: Following a Page Inquiry Command, this field indicates if the Page is owned by the entity that issued the inquiry, owned by another entity, or unowned
BitField.name: PO

Enum.description: Available; Unowned: The entity that issued the inquiry may allocate this page to a partition. No zeroization is needed since it has already been cleared, therefore no interrupt should be expected.
Enum.name: AVAILABLE

Enum.description: Page does not exist in this version or is not initialized yet.
Enum.name: NOT_PRESENT_OR_INITIALIZED

Enum.description: Another entity owns the page. This page is unavailable to the issuer of the inquiry.
Enum.name: UNAVAILABLE

Enum.description: Owned by the entity making the inquiry. The owner may de-allocate this page if its partition is not marked PSP. If the partition to which the page is allocated is designated as CSP, the page will be zeroized upon de-allocation.
Enum.name: OWNED

Enum.description: No Error.
Enum.name: NO_ERROR

Enum.description: Command has not yet completed.
Enum.name: CMD_INCOMPLETE_ERROR

Enum.description: A security failure occurred.
Enum.name: SECURITY_FAILURE

Enum.description: Command Overflow. Another command was issued by the same Job Ring owner before the owner's previous command completed. The additional command was ignored.
Enum.name: CMD_OVERFLOW_ERROR

Register.description: Recoverable Error Interrupt Record 0 for Job Ring 2
Register.name: REIR0JR2

BitField.description: This field indicates the type of the recoverable error
BitField.name: TYPE

BitField.description: If MISS=1, a second recoverable error associated with JR occurred before REIR0JR was written following a previous JR recoverable error
BitField.name: MISS

Register.description: Recoverable Error Interrupt Record 2 for Job Ring 2
Register.name: REIR2JR2

BitField.description: Address associated with the recoverable JR error.
BitField.name: ADDR

Register.description: Recoverable Error Interrupt Record 4 for Job Ring 2
Register.name: REIR4JR2

BitField.description: This field holds the ICID associated with the recoverable error.
BitField.name: ICID

BitField.description: This field holds the DID associated with the recoverable error.
BitField.name: DID

BitField.description: This field holds the AXI cache control transaction attribute used for the memory access.
BitField.name: AXCACHE

BitField.description: This field holds the AXI protection transaction attribute used for the memory access.
BitField.name: AXPROT

BitField.description: This field specifies whether the memory access was a read or write.
BitField.name: RWB

BitField.description: This field holds the AXI error response associated with the recoverable error.
BitField.name: ERR

BitField.description: This field holds the memory interface index associated with the recoverable error.
BitField.name: MIX

Register.description: Recoverable Error Interrupt Record 5 for Job Ring 2
Register.name: REIR5JR2

BitField.description: This field holds the block identifier (see Internal Block ID) of the source of the AXI transaction associated with the recoverable error
BitField.name: BID

BitField.description: This field indicates whether the bus transaction associated with the recoverable error was initiating an CAAM Secure Memory blob operation
BitField.name: BNDG

BitField.description: This field indicates whether the bus transaction associated with the recoverable error was an attempt to assert trusted descriptor privilege when accessing an CAAM Secure Memory partition
BitField.name: TDSC

BitField.description: This field indicates whether the bus transaction associated with the recoverable error was an attempt to read the key modifier associated with an CAAM Secure Memory partition
BitField.name: KMOD

BitField.description: This field indicates whether the bus transaction associated with the recoverable error was an attempted key access to CAAM Secure Memory
BitField.name: KEY

BitField.description: This field indicates whether the bus transaction associated with the recoverable error was an attempted access to CAAM Secure Memory
BitField.name: SMA

Enum.description: No Status Source (No Error or Status Reported)

Register.description: Job Ring Interrupt Status Register for Job Ring 3
Register.name: JRINTR_JR3

Enum.description: Error writing status to Output Ring
Enum.name: OR_WR_ERR

Enum.description: Bad input ring base address (not on a 4-byte boundary).
Enum.name: BAD_IR_ADDR_ERR

Enum.description: Bad output ring base address (not on a 4-byte boundary).
Enum.name: BAD_OR_ADDR_ERR

Enum.description: Invalid write to Input Ring Base Address Register or Input Ring Size Register. Can be written when there are no jobs in the input ring or when the Job Ring is halted. These are fatal and will likely result in not being able to get all jobs out into the output ring for processing by software. Resetting the job ring will almost certainly be necessary.
Enum.name: INV_IR_REG_WR_ERR

Enum.description: Invalid write to Output Ring Base Address Register or Output Ring Size Register. Can be written when there are no jobs in the output ring and no jobs from this queue are already processing in CAAM (in the holding tanks or DECOs), or when the Job Ring is halted.
Enum.name: INV_OR_REG_WR_ERR

Enum.description: Job Ring reset released before Job Ring is halted.
Enum.name: INV_JR_RESET_ERR

Enum.description: Removed too many jobs (ORJRR larger than ORSFR).
Enum.name: ORJRR_GT_ORSFR_ERR

Enum.description: Added too many jobs (IRJAR larger than IRSAR).
Enum.name: IRJAR_GT_IRSAR_ERR

Enum.description: Writing ORSF > ORS In these error cases the write is ignored, the interrupt is asserted (unless masked) and the error bit and error_type fields are set in the Job Ring Interrupt Status Register.
Enum.name: ORSF_GT_ORS_ERR

Enum.description: Writing IRSA > IRS
Enum.name: IRSA_GT_IRS_ERR

Enum.description: Writing ORWI > ORS in bytes
Enum.name: ORWI_GT_ORS_ERR

Enum.description: Writing IRRI > IRS in bytes
Enum.name: IRRI_GT_IRS_ERR

Enum.description: Writing IRSA when ring is active
Enum.name: INV_IRSA_WR_ERR

Enum.description: Writing IRRI when ring is active
Enum.name: INV_IRRI_WR_ERR

Enum.description: Writing ORSF when ring is active
Enum.name: INV_ORSF_WR_ERR

Enum.description: Writing ORWI when ring is active
Enum.name: INV_ORWI_WR_ERR

BitField.description: Output ring write index with error
BitField.name: ERR_ORWI

BitField.description: To assist with mixed Endianness platforms, this bit configures a byte swap of message data read by CAAM DMA
BitField.name: MBSI

BitField.description: To assist with mixed Endianness platforms, this bit configures a halfword swap of message data read by CAAM DMA
BitField.name: MHWSI

BitField.description: To assist with mixed Endianness platforms, this bit configures a fullword swap of message data read by CAAM DMA
BitField.name: MWSI

BitField.description: To assist with mixed Endianness platforms, this bit configures a byte swap of control data read by CAAM DMA
BitField.name: CBSI

BitField.description: To assist with mixed Endianness platforms, this bit configures a halfword swap of control data read by CAAM DMA
BitField.name: CHWSI

BitField.description: To assist with mixed Endianness platforms, this bit configures a fullword swap of control data read by CAAM DMA
BitField.name: CWSI

BitField.description: To assist with mixed Endianness platforms, this bit configures a byte swap of message data written by CAAM DMA
BitField.name: MBSO

BitField.description: To assist with mixed Endianness platforms, this bit configures a halfword swap of message data written by CAAM DMA
BitField.name: MHWSO

BitField.description: To assist with mixed Endianness platforms, this bit configures a fullword swap of message data written by CAAM DMA
BitField.name: MWSO

BitField.description: To assist with mixed Endianness platforms, this bit configures a byte swap of control data written by CAAM DMA
BitField.name: CBSO

BitField.description: To assist with mixed Endianness platforms, this bit configures a halfword swap of control data written by CAAM DMA
BitField.name: CHWSO

BitField.description: To assist with mixed Endianness platforms, this bit configures a fullword swap of control data written by CAAM DMA
BitField.name: CWSO

BitField.description: Descriptor Message Data Byte Swap (this applies only to internal message data transfers to/from DECO Descriptor Buffers)
BitField.name: DMBS

BitField.description: Platform Endian Override - The bit is XORed with the PLEND bit in the CaCSTA Register and the other "swap" bits in the Job Ring Configuration Register to determine the AXI Master's view of memory endianness when executing Job Descriptors from this Job Ring
BitField.name: PEO

Register.description: Job Ring Configuration Register for Job Ring 3, least-significant half
Register.name: JRCFGR_JR3_LS

BitField.description: Interrupt Mask. Mask the interrupt that is associated with the particular processor.
BitField.name: IMSK

Enum.description: Interrupt enabled.
Enum.name: INTR_ENABLED

Enum.description: Interrupt masked.
Enum.name: INTR_MASKED

Enum.description: Interrupt coalescing is disabled. If the IMSK bit is cleared, an interrupt is asserted whenever a job is written to the output ring. ICDCT is ignored. Note that if software removes one or more jobs and clears the interrupt but the output rings slots full is still greater than 0 (ORSF > 0), then the interrupt will clear but reassert on the next clock cycle.
Enum.name: INTR_COAL_DISABLED

Enum.description: Interrupt coalescing is enabled. If the IMSK bit is cleared, an interrupt is asserted whenever the threshold number of frames is reached (ICDCT) or when the threshold timer expires (ICTT). Note that if software removes one or more jobs and clears the interrupt but the interrupt coalescing threshold is still met (ORSF >= ICDCT), then the interrupt will clear but reassert on the next clock cycle.
Enum.name: INTR_COAL_ENABLED

Register.name: IRRIR_JR3

Register.description: Output Ring Write Index Register for Job Ring 3
Register.name: ORWIR_JR3

BitField.name: ORWI

Register.description: Job Ring Command Register for Job Ring 3
Register.name: JRCR_JR3

BitField.description: Reset - When RESET is 0, software writes a 1 to RESET to request a flush of the Job Ring
BitField.name: RESET

BitField.description: Park - When PARK is 0, software writes a 1 to PARK to request that the Job Ring be "parked", i
BitField.name: PARK

Enum.description: Instruction fetches and reads are prohibited (except that Trusted Descriptor reads (if G1_TDO=1) and key-reads are always allowed, and exporting Secure Memory Blobs is allowed if G1_SMBLOB=1 or if done by a Trusted Descriptor and G1_TDO=1).
Enum.name: G1_READ_PROHIB

Enum.description: Instruction fetches and reads are allowed (but exporting a Secure Memory Blob is prohibited if G1_SMBLOB=0 and the descriptor is not a Trusted Descriptor or if G1_TDO=0).
Enum.name: G1_READ_ALLOWED

Enum.description: Writes are prohibited (except that Trusted Descriptor writes are allowed, and importing Secure Memory Blobs is allowed if G1_SMBLOB=1 or if done by a Trusted Descriptor and G1_TDO=1).
Enum.name: G1_WRITE_PROHIB

Enum.description: Writes are allowed (but importing a Secure Memory Blob is prohibited if G1_SMBLOB=0 and the descriptor is not a Trusted Descriptor or if G1_TDO=0).
Enum.name: G1_WRITE_ALLOWED

Enum.description: Trusted Descriptors have the same access privileges as Job Descriptors
Enum.name: G1_TD_PRIVILEGE_AS_JD

Enum.description: Trusted Descriptors are allowed to override the other access permissions, i.e. they can export blobs from or import blobs to the partition and read from and write to the partition regardless of the G1_SMBLOB, G1_WRITE and G1_READ settings.
Enum.name: G1_TD_OVERIDE_ALLOWED

Enum.description: Exporting or importing Secure Memory Blobs is prohibited, unless done via a Trusted Descriptor and G1_TDO=1.
Enum.name: G1_SM_BLOB_EXPORT_IMPORT_PROHIB

Enum.description: Exporting or importing Secure Memory Blobs is allowed, regardless of the G1_READ and G1_WRITE settings.
Enum.name: G1_SM_B_EXPORT_IMPORT_ALLOWED

Enum.description: Instruction fetches and reads are prohibited (except that Trusted Descriptor reads (if G2_TDO=1) and key-reads are always allowed, and exporting Secure Memory Blobs is allowed if G2_SMBLOB=1 or if done by a Trusted Descriptor and G2_TDO=1).
Enum.name: G2_READ_PROHIB

Enum.description: Instruction fetches and reads are allowed (but exporting a Secure Memory Blob is prohibited if G2_SMBLOB=0 and the descriptor is not a Trusted Descriptor or if G2_TDO=0).
Enum.name: G2_READ_ALLOWED

Enum.description: Writes are prohibited (except that Trusted Descriptor writes are allowed, and importing Secure Memory Blobs is allowed if G2_SMBLOB=1 or if done by a Trusted Descriptor and G2_TDO=1).
Enum.name: G2_WRITE_PROHIB

Enum.description: Writes are allowed (but importing a Secure Memory Blob is prohibited if G2_SMBLOB=0 and the descriptor is not a Trusted Descriptor or if G2_TDO=0).
Enum.name: G2_WRITE_ALLOWED

Enum.description: Trusted Descriptors have the same access privileges as Job Descriptors
Enum.name: G2_TD_PRIVILEGE_AS_JD

Enum.description: Trusted Descriptors are allowed to override the other access permissions, i.e. they can export blobs from or import blobs to the partition and read from and write to the partition regardless of the G2_SMBLOB, G2_WRITE and G2_READ settings.
Enum.name: G2_TD_OVERIDE_ALLOWED

Enum.description: Exporting or importing Secure Memory Blobs is prohibited, unless done via a Trusted Descriptor and G2_TDO=1.
Enum.name: G2_SM_BLOB_EXPORT_IMPORT_PROHIB

Enum.description: Exporting or importing Secure Memory Blobs is allowed, regardless of the G2_READ and G2_WRITE settings.
Enum.name: G2_SM_BLOB_EXPORT_IMPORT_ALLOWED

Enum.description: The SMAG2JR register and SMAG1JR register are unlocked. The partition owner can change any writable bits of these registers.
Enum.name: SMAG_UNLOCKED

Enum.description: The SMAG2JR register and SMAG1JR register are locked. The SMAG2JR and SMAG1JR registers cannot be changed until the partition is de-allocated or a POR occurs.
Enum.name: SMAG_LOCKED

Enum.description: The SMAP register is unlocked. The partition owner can change any writable bits of the SMAP register.
Enum.name: SMAP_UNLOCKED

Enum.description: The SMAP register is locked. The SMAP_LCK, CSP and PSP bits and G1 and G2 permission bits of the SMAP register cannot be changed until the partition is de-allocated or a POR occurs. The PARTITION_KMOD value can still be changed. The SMAG_LCK bit can be changed to a 1, but cannot be changed to a 0.
Enum.name: SMAP_LOCKED

Enum.description: The partition and any of the pages allocated to the partition can be de-allocated.
Enum.name: NOT_DEALLOCATABLE

Enum.description: The partition cannot be de-allocated and the pages allocated to the partition cannot be de-allocated.
Enum.name: DEALLOCATABLE

Enum.description: The pages allocated to the partition will not be zeroized when they are de-allocated or the partition is released or a security alarm occurs.
Enum.name: NOT_ZEROIZED

Enum.description: The pages allocated to the partition will be zeroized when they are individually de-allocated or the partition is released or a security alarm occurs.
Enum.name: ZEROIZED

Enum.description: The SMAG2JR register and SMAG1JR register are unlocked. The partition owner can change any writable bits of these registers.
Enum.name: SMAG_UNLOCKED

Enum.description: The SMAG2JR register and SMAG1JR register are locked. The SMAG2JR and SMAG1JR registers cannot be changed until the partition is de-allocated or a POR occurs.
Enum.name: SMAG_LOCKED

Enum.description: The SMAP register is unlocked. The partition owner can change any writable bits of the SMAP register.
Enum.name: SMAP_UNLOCKED

Enum.description: The SMAP register is locked. The SMAP_LCK, CSP and PSP bits and G1 and G2 permission bits of the SMAP register cannot be changed until the partition is de-allocated or a POR occurs. Enum.name: NOT_ZEROIZED

Enum.description: The pages allocated to the partition will be zeroized when they are individually de-allocated or the partition is released or a security alarm occurs.
Enum.name: ZEROIZED

Enum.description: Instruction fetches and reads are prohibited (except that Trusted Descriptor reads (if G1_TDO=1) and key-reads are always allowed, and exporting Secure Memory Blobs is allowed if G1_SMBLOB=1 or if done by a Trusted Descriptor and G1_TDO=1).
Enum.name: G1_READ_PROHIB

Enum.description: Instruction fetches and reads are allowed (but exporting a Secure Memory Blob is prohibited if G1_SMBLOB=0 and the descriptor is not a Trusted Descriptor or if G1_TDO=0).
Enum.name: G1_READ_ALLOWED

Enum.description: Writes are prohibited (except that Trusted Descriptor writes are allowed, and importing Secure Memory Blobs is allowed if G1_SMBLOB=1 or if done by a Trusted Descriptor and G1_TDO=1).
Enum.name: G1_WRITE_PROHIB

Enum.description: Writes are allowed (but importing a Secure Memory Blob is prohibited if G1_SMBLOB=0 and the descriptor is not a Trusted Descriptor or if G1_TDO=0).
Enum.name: G1_WRITE_ALLOWED

Enum.description: Trusted Descriptors have the same access privileges as Job Descriptors
Enum.name: G1_TD_PRIVILEGE_AS_JD

Enum.description: Trusted Descriptors are allowed to override the other access permissions, i.e. they can export blobs from or import blobs to the partition and read from and write to the partition regardless of the G1_SMBLOB, G1_WRITE and G1_READ settings.
Enum.name: G1_TD_OVERIDE_ALLOWED

Enum.description: Exporting or importing Secure Memory Blobs is prohibited, unless done via a Trusted Descriptor and G1_TDO=1.
Enum.name: G1_SM_BLOB_EXPORT_IMPORT_PROHIB

Enum.description: Exporting or importing Secure Memory Blobs is allowed, regardless of the G1_READ and G1_WRITE settings.
Enum.name: G1_SM_B_EXPORT_IMPORT_ALLOWED

Enum.description: Instruction fetches and reads are prohibited (except that Trusted Descriptor reads (if G2_TDO=1) and key-reads are always allowed, and exporting Secure Memory Blobs is allowed if G2_SMBLOB=1 or if done by a Trusted Descriptor and G2_TDO=1).
Enum.name: G2_READ_PROHIB

Enum.description: Instruction fetches and reads are allowed (but exporting a Secure Memory Blob is prohibited if G2_SMBLOB=0 and the descriptor is not a Trusted Descriptor or if G2_TDO=0).
Enum.name: G2_READ_ALLOWED

Enum.description: Writes are prohibited (except that Trusted Descriptor writes are allowed, and importing Secure Memory Blobs is allowed if G2_SMBLOB=1 or if done by a Trusted Descriptor and G2_TDO=1).
Enum.name: G2_WRITE_PROHIB

Enum.description: Writes are allowed (but importing a Secure Memory Blob is prohibited if G2_SMBLOB=0 and the descriptor is not a Trusted Descriptor or if G2_TDO=0).
Enum.name: G2_WRITE_ALLOWED

Enum.description: Trusted Descriptors have the same access privileges as Job Descriptors
Enum.name: G2_TD_PRIVILEGE_AS_JD

Enum.description: Trusted Descriptors are allowed to override the other access permissions, i.e. they can export blobs from or import blobs to the partition and read from and write to the partition regardless of the G2_SMBLOB, G2_WRITE and G2_READ settings.
Enum.name: G2_TD_OVERIDE_ALLOWED

Enum.description: Exporting or importing Secure Memory Blobs is prohibited, unless done via a Trusted Descriptor and G2_TDO=1.
Enum.name: G2_SM_BLOB_EXPORT_IMPORT_PROHIB

Enum.description: Exporting or importing Secure Memory Blobs is allowed, regardless of the G2_READ and G2_WRITE settings.
Enum.name: G2_SM_BLOB_EXPORT_IMPORT_ALLOWED

Enum.description: The SMAG2JR register and SMAG1JR register are unlocked. The partition owner can change any writable bits of these registers.
Enum.name: SMAG_UNLOCKED

Enum.description: The SMAG2JR register and SMAG1JR register are locked. The SMAG2JR and SMAG1JR registers cannot be changed until the partition is de-allocated or a POR occurs.
Enum.name: SMAG_LOCKED

Enum.description: The SMAP register is unlocked. The partition owner can change any writable bits of the SMAP register.
Enum.name: SMAP_UNLOCKED

Enum.description: The SMAP register is locked. The SMAP_LCK, CSP and PSP bits and G1 and G2 permission bits of the SMAP register cannot be changed until the partition is de-allocated or a POR occurs. The PARTITION_KMOD value can still be changed. The SMAG_LCK bit can be changed to a 1, but cannot be changed to a 0.
Enum.name: SMAP_LOCKED

Enum.description: The partition and any of the pages allocated to the partition can be de-allocated.
Enum.name: NOT_DEALLOCATABLE

Enum.description: The partition cannot be de-allocated and the pages allocated to the partition cannot be de-allocated.
Enum.name: DEALLOCATABLE

Enum.description: The pages allocated to the partition will not be zeroized when they are de-allocated or the partition is released or a security alarm occurs.
Enum.name: NOT_ZEROIZED

Enum.description: The pages allocated to the partition will be zeroized when they are individually de-allocated or the partition is released or a security alarm occurs.
Enum.name: ZEROIZED

BitField.description: Command: 1h: Allocate Page - This command allocates the page specified in the PAGE field to the partition specified in the PRTN field
BitField.name: CMD

BitField.description: Partition: When an Allocate Page or De-allocate Partition command is issued, the action is performed on the partition indicated in the PRTN field
BitField.name: PRTN

BitField.description: This is the number of the page to be referenced in field CMD
BitField.name: PAGE

BitField.description: Following a Page Inquiry Command, if the PO field is 10 or 11, this field indicates the partition to which the page specified in the PAGE field is allocated
BitField.name: PRTN

BitField.description: Page Owner: Following a Page Inquiry Command, this field indicates if the Page is owned by the entity that issued the inquiry, owned by another entity, or unowned
BitField.name: PO

Enum.description: Available; Unowned: The entity that issued the inquiry may allocate this page to a partition. No zeroization is needed since it has already been cleared, therefore no interrupt should be expected.
Enum.name: AVAILABLE

Enum.description: Page does not exist in this version or is not initialized yet.
Enum.name: NOT_PRESENT_OR_INITIALIZED

Enum.description: Another entity owns the page. This page is unavailable to the issuer of the inquiry.
Enum.name: UNAVAILABLE

Enum.description: Owned by the entity making the inquiry. The owner may de-allocate this page if its partition is not marked PSP. If the partition to which the page is allocated is designated as CSP, the page will be zeroized upon de-allocation.
Enum.name: OWNED

Enum.description: No Error.
Enum.name: NO_ERROR

Enum.description: Command has not yet completed.
Enum.name: CMD_INCOMPLETE_ERROR

Enum.description: A security failure occurred.
Enum.name: SECURITY_FAILURE

Enum.description: Command Overflow. Another command was issued by the same Job Ring owner before the owner's previous command completed. The additional command was ignored.
Enum.name: CMD_OVERFLOW_ERROR

Register.description: Recoverable Error Interrupt Record 0 for Job Ring 3
Register.name: REIR0JR3

BitField.description: This field indicates the type of the recoverable error
BitField.name: TYPE

BitField.description: If MISS=1, a second recoverable error associated with JR occurred before REIR0JR was written following a previous JR recoverable error
BitField.name: MISS

Register.description: Recoverable Error Interrupt Record 2 for Job Ring 3
Register.name: REIR2JR3

BitField.description: Address associated with the recoverable JR error.
BitField.name: ADDR

Register.description: Recoverable Error Interrupt Record 4 for Job Ring 3
Register.name: REIR4JR3

BitField.description: This field holds the ICID associated with the recoverable error.
BitField.name: ICID

BitField.description: This field holds the DID associated with the recoverable error.
BitField.name: DID

BitField.description: This field holds the AXI cache control transaction attribute used for the memory access.
BitField.name: AXCACHE

BitField.description: This field holds the AXI protection transaction attribute used for the memory access.
BitField.name: AXPROT

BitField.description: This field specifies whether the memory access was a read or write.
BitField.name: RWB

BitField.description: This field holds the AXI error response associated with the recoverable error.
BitField.name: ERR

BitField.description: This field holds the memory interface index associated with the recoverable error.
BitField.name: MIX

Register.description: Recoverable Error Interrupt Record 5 for Job Ring 3
Register.name: REIR5JR3

BitField.description: This field holds the block identifier (see Internal Block ID) of the source of the AXI transaction associated with the recoverable error
BitField.name: BID

BitField.description: This field indicates whether the bus transaction associated with the recoverable error was initiating an CAAM Secure Memory blob operation
BitField.name: BNDG

BitField.description: This field indicates whether the bus transaction associated with the recoverable error was an attempt to assert trusted descriptor privilege when accessing an CAAM Secure Memory partition
BitField.name: TDSC

BitField.description: This field indicates whether the bus transaction associated with the recoverable error was an attempt to read the key modifier associated with an CAAM Secure Memory partition
BitField.name: KMOD

BitField.description: This field indicates whether the bus transaction associated with the recoverable error was an attempted key access to CAAM Secure Memory
BitField.name: KEY

BitField.description: This field indicates whether the bus transaction associated with the recoverable error was an attempted access to CAAM Secure Memory
BitField.name: SMA

BitField.description: When this bit is set by software, the LCDIF will begin transferring data between the SoC and the display
BitField.name: RUN

Enum.description: Data input to the block is in 24 bpp format, such that all RGB 888 data is contained in 24 bits.
Enum.name: ALL_24_BITS_VALID

Enum.description: Data input to the block is actually RGB 18 bpp, but there is 1 color per byte, hence the upper 2 bits in each byte do not contain any useful data, and should be dropped.
Enum.name: DROP_UPPER_2_BITS_PER_BYTE

Enum.description: Data input to the block is in 18 bpp format, such that lower 18 bits contain RGB 666 and upper 14 bits do not contain any useful data.
Enum.name: LOWER_18_BITS_VALID

Enum.description: Data input to the block is in 18 bpp format, such that upper 18 bits contain RGB 666 and lower 14 bits do not contain any useful data.
Enum.name: UPPER_18_BITS_VALID

BitField.description: When this bit is 1 and WORD_LENGTH = 0, it implies that the 16-bit data is in ARGB555 format
BitField.name: DATA_FORMAT_16_BIT

BitField.description: Set this bit to make the LCDIF act as a bus master
BitField.name: MASTER

BitField.description: If this bit is set and LCDIF_MASTER bit is set, the LCDIF will act as bus master and the handshake mechanism between LCDIF and PXP will be turned on
BitField.name: ENABLE_PXP_HANDSHAKE

Enum.description: Input data is 16 bits per pixel.

Enum.name: 8_BIT

Enum.name: 18_BIT

Enum.description: Input data is 24 bits per pixel.
Enum.name: 24_BIT

BitField.name: LCD_DATABUS_WIDTH

Enum.name: 8_BIT

Enum.name: 24_BIT

BitField.description: This field specifies how to swap the bytes after the data has been converted into an internal representation of 24 bits per pixel and before it is transmitted over the LCD interface bus
BitField.name: CSC_DATA_SWIZZLE

Enum.description: No byte swapping.(Little endian)
Enum.name: NO_SWAP

Enum.description: Big Endian swap (swap bytes 0,3 and 1,2).
Enum.name: BIG_ENDIAN_SWAP

Enum.description: Swap half-words.
Enum.name: HWD_SWAP

Enum.description: Swap bytes within each half-word.
Enum.name: HWD_BYTE_SWAP

BitField.description: This field specifies how to swap the bytes fetched by the bus master interface

BitField.description: This bit must be set to zero to enable normal operation of the LCDIF
BitField.name: SFTRST

BitField.description: When this bit is set by software, the LCDIF will begin transferring data between the SoC and the display

Enum.description: Data input to the block is in 24 bpp format, such that all RGB 888 data is contained in 24 bits.
Enum.name: ALL_24_BITS_VALID

Enum.description: Data input to the block is actually RGB 18 bpp, but there is 1 color per byte, hence the upper 2 bits in each byte do not contain any useful data, and should be dropped.

Enum.description: Data input to the block is in 18 bpp format, such that lower 18 bits contain RGB 666 and upper 14 bits do not contain any useful data.

Enum.description: Data input to the block is in 18 bpp format, such that upper 18 bits contain RGB 666 and lower 14 bits do not contain any useful data.
Enum.name: UPPER_18_BITS_VALID

BitField.description: Default 0 for counting VSYNC_PERIOD in terms of DISPLAY CLOCK (pix_clk) cycles
BitField.name: VSYNC_PERIOD_UNIT

BitField.description: Default 0 active low during valid data transfer on each horizontal line.
BitField.name: ENABLE_POL

BitField.description: Default is data launched at negative edge of DOTCLK and captured at positive edge
BitField.name: DOTCLK_POL

BitField.description: Default 0 active low during HSYNC_PULSE_WIDTH time and will be high during the rest of the HSYNC period
BitField.name: HSYNC_POL

BitField.description: Default 0 active low during VSYNC_PULSE_WIDTH time and will be high during the rest of the VSYNC period
BitField.name: VSYNC_POL

BitField.description: Setting this bit to 1 will make the hardware generate the ENABLE signal in the DOTCLK mode, thereby making it the true RGB interface along with the remaining three signals VSYNC, HSYNC and DOTCLK
BitField.name: ENABLE_PRESENT

BitField.description: 0 means the VSYNC signal is an output, 1 means it is an input
BitField.name: VSYNC_OEB

Enum.description: The VSYNC pin is in the output mode and the VSYNC signal has to be generated by the LCDIF block.
Enum.name: VSYNC_OUTPUT

Enum.description: The VSYNC pin is in the input mode and the LCD controller sends the VSYNC signal to the block.
Enum.name: VSYNC_INPUT

Register.description: LCDIF VSYNC Mode and Dotclk Mode Control Register0
Register.name: LCDIF_VDCTRL0_TOG

BitField.description: Number of units for which VSYNC signal is active
BitField.name: VSYNC_PULSE_WIDTH

BitField.description: When this bit is 0, the first field (VSYNC period) will end in half a horizontal line and the second field will begin with half a horizontal line
BitField.name: HALF_LINE_MODE

BitField.description: Setting this bit to 1 will make the total VSYNC period equal to the VSYNC_PERIOD field plus half the HORIZONTAL_PERIOD field (i
BitField.name: HALF_LINE

BitField.description: Default 0 for counting VSYNC_PULSE_WIDTH in terms of DISPLAY CLOCK (pix_clk) cycles
BitField.name: VSYNC_PULSE_WIDTH_UNIT

BitField.description: Default 0 for counting VSYNC_PERIOD in terms of DISPLAY CLOCK (pix_clk) cycles
BitField.name: VSYNC_PERIOD_UNIT

BitField.description: Default 0 active low during valid data transfer on each horizontal line.
BitField.name: ENABLE_POL

BitField.description: Default is data launched at negative edge of DOTCLK and captured at positive edge
BitField.name: DOTCLK_POL

BitField.description: Default 0 active low during HSYNC_PULSE_WIDTH time and will be high during the rest of the HSYNC period
BitField.name: HSYNC_POL

BitField.description: Default 0 active low during VSYNC_PULSE_WIDTH time and will be high during the rest of the VSYNC period
BitField.name: VSYNC_POL

BitField.description: Setting this bit to 1 will make the hardware generate the ENABLE signal in the DOTCLK mode, thereby making it the true RGB interface along with the remaining three signals VSYNC, HSYNC and DOTCLK
BitField.name: ENABLE_PRESENT

BitField.description: 0 means the VSYNC signal is an output, 1 means it is an input
BitField.name: VSYNC_OEB

Enum.description: The VSYNC pin is in the output mode and the VSYNC signal has to be generated by the LCDIF block.
Enum.name: VSYNC_OUTPUT

Register.description: LCDIF VSYNC Mode and Dotclk Mode Control Register1
Register.name: LCDIF_VDCTRL1

BitField.description: Total number of units between two positive or two negative edges of the VSYNC signal
BitField.name: VSYNC_PERIOD

Register.description: LCDIF VSYNC Mode and Dotclk Mode Control Register2
Register.name: LCDIF_VDCTRL2

BitField.description: Total number of DISPLAY CLOCK (pix_clk) cycles between two positive or two negative edges of the HSYNC signal
BitField.name: HSYNC_PERIOD

BitField.description: Number of DISPLAY CLOCK (pix_clk) cycles for which HSYNC signal is active.
BitField.name: HSYNC_PULSE_WIDTH

Register.description: LCDIF VSYNC Mode and Dotclk Mode Control Register3
Register.name: LCDIF_VDCTRL3

BitField.description: In the VSYNC interface mode, wait for this number of DISPLAY CLOCK (pix_clk) cycles from the falling VSYNC edge (or rising if VSYNC_POL is 1) before starting LCD transactions and is applicable only if WAIT_FOR_VSYNC_EDGE is set
BitField.name: VERTICAL_WAIT_CNT

BitField.description: In the DOTCLK mode, wait for this number of clocks from falling edge (or rising if HSYNC_POL is 1) of HSYNC signal to account for horizontal back porch plus the number of DOTCLKs before the moving picture information begins
BitField.name: HORIZONTAL_WAIT_CNT

BitField.description: This bit must be set to 1 in the VSYNC mode of operation, and 0 in the DOTCLK mode of operation.
BitField.name: VSYNC_ONLY

BitField.description: When this bit is set, the LCDIF block will internally mux HSYNC with LCD_D14, DOTCLK with LCD_D13 and ENABLE with LCD_D12, otherwise these signals will go out on separate pins
BitField.name: MUX_SYNC_SIGNALS

Register.description: LCDIF VSYNC Mode and Dotclk Mode Control Register4
Register.name: LCDIF_VDCTRL4

BitField.description: Total number of DISPLAY CLOCK (pix_clk) cycles on each horizontal line that carry valid data in DOTCLK mode
BitField.name: DOTCLK_H_VALID_DATA_CNT

BitField.description: Set this field to 1 if the LCD controller requires that the VSYNC or VSYNC/HSYNC/DOTCLK control signals should be active at least one frame before the data transfers actually start and remain active at least one frame after the data transfers end
BitField.name: SYNC_SIGNALS_ON

BitField.description: This bitfield selects the amount of time by which the DOTCLK signal should be delayed before coming out of the LCD_DOTCK pin
BitField.name: DOTCLK_DLY_SEL

BitField.description: Virtual address at which bus master error occurred.
BitField.name: ADDR

BitField.description: Read only view of the current count in Latency buffer (LFIFO).

BitField.description: Read only view of the signals that indicates LCD TXFIFO is empty.

BitField.description: Read only view of the signals that indicates LCD TXFIFO is full.
BitField.name: TXFIFO_FULL

BitField.description: Read only view of the signals that indicates LCD LFIFO is empty.
BitField.name: LFIFO_EMPTY

BitField.description: Read only view of the signals that indicates LCD LFIFO is full.
BitField.name: LFIFO_FULL

BitField.description: Reflects the current state of the DMA Request line for the LCDIF
BitField.name: DMA_REQ

BitField.description: 0: LCDIF not present on this product 1: LCDIF is present.
BitField.name: PRESENT

BitField.name: UV_OFFSET

BitField.name: C0

BitField.description: Enable the CSC unit in the LCDIFv2 plane data path
BitField.name: ENABLE

Enum.description: The CSC is bypassed and the input pixels are RGB data already
Enum.name: ENABLE_0

Enum.description: The CSC is enabled and the pixels will be converted to RGB data
Enum.name: ENABLE_1

Enum.description: Converting YUV to RGB data
Enum.name: YCBCR_MODE_0

Enum.description: Converting YCbCr to RGB data
Enum.name: YCBCR_MODE_1

BitField.name: C4

BitField.description: Two's compliment Red V/Cr multiplier coefficient. YUV=0x123 (1.140) YCbCr=0x198 (1.596)
BitField.name: C1

BitField.description: Two's compliment Green U/Cb multiplier coefficient. YUV=0x79C (-0.394) YCbCr=0x79C (-0.392)
BitField.name: C3

BitField.description: Two's compliment Green V/Cr multiplier coefficient. YUV=0x76B (-0.581) YCbCr=0x730 (-0.813)
BitField.name: C2

BitField.name: HEIGHT

BitField.name: POSX

BitField.name: POSY

BitField.name: NUM_LANES

Enum.description: 2 lanes
Enum.name: NUM_LANES_1

BitField.description: Sets the Host Controller into non-continuous MIPI clock mode. When in non-continuous clock mode, the high speed clock will transition into low power mode between transmissions.
BitField.name: CLK_MODE

Enum.description: Continuous high speed clock
Enum.name: CLK_MODE_0

Enum.description: Non-Continuous high speed clock
Enum.name: CLK_MODE_1

BitField.description: Sets the number of byte clock periods ('clk_byte' input) that the controller will wait after enabling the clock lane for HS operation before enabling the data lanes for HS operation. This setting represents the TCLK-PRE DPHY timing parameter. The minimum value for this port is 1.
BitField.name: NUM_PERIODS

BitField.description: Sets the number of byte clock periods ('clk_byte' input) to wait before putting the clock lane into LP mode after the data lanes have been detected to be in Stop State. This setting represents the DPHY timing parameters TLPX + TCLK-PREPARE + TCLK-ZERO + TCLK-PRE requirement for the clock lane before the data lane is allowed to change from LP11 to start a high speed transmission. The minimum value for this port is 1.
BitField.name: NUM_PERIODS

BitField.description: Sets the number of byte clock periods ('clk_byte' input) that the controller will wait after the clock lane has been put into LP mode before enabling the clock lane for HS mode again. This setting represents the THS-EXIT DPHY timing parameter. The minimum value for this port is 1.
BitField.name: NUM_PERIODS

BitField.description: Enables the Host Controller to automatically insert an EoTp short packet when switching from HS to LP mode.
BitField.name: AUTOINSERT

Enum.description: EoTp is not automatically inserted
Enum.name: NOT_AUTO

Enum.description: EoTp is automatically inserted
Enum.name: AUTO

BitField.description: Configures the DSI Host Controller to send extra End Of Transmission Packets after the end of a packet. The value is the number of extra EOTP packets sent.
BitField.name: EXTRA_EOTP

BitField.description: Sets the value of the DSI Host High Speed TX timeout count in clk_byte clock periods that once reached will initiate a timeout error and follow the recovery procedure documented in the DSI specification.
BitField.name: COUNT

BitField.description: Sets the value of the DSI Host low power RX timeout count in clk_byte clock periods that once reached will initiate a timeout error and follow the recovery procedure documented in the DSI specification.
BitField.name: COUNT

BitField.description: Sets the value of the DSI Host Bus Turn Around (BTA) timeout in clk_byte clock periods that once reached will initiate a timeout error.
BitField.name: COUNT

BitField.description: DPHY Twakeup timing parameter. Sets the number of clk_esc clock periods to keep a clock or data lane in Mark-1 state after exiting ULPS. The MIPI DPHY spec requires a minimum of 1ms in Mark-1 state after leaving ULPS.
BitField.name: NUM_PERIODS

Enum.description: Counter disable mode: not use step counter, step completes once receiving step_done
Enum.name: b0

Enum.name: b1

Enum.description: Ignore step_done response, the counter starts to count once step begins, when counter reaches STEP_CNT value, the step completes
Enum.name: b2

Enum.description: Time out mode, the counter starts to count once step begins, the step completes when either step_done received or counting to STEP_CNT value
Enum.name: b3

Enum.description: Counter delay mode: delay after receiving step_done, delay cycle number is STEP_CNT
Enum.name: b1

Enum.description: Ignore step_done response, the counter starts to count once step begins, when counter reaches STEP_CNT value, the step completes
Enum.name: b2

Enum.description: Time out mode, the counter starts to count once step begins, the step completes when either step_done received or counting to STEP_CNT value
Enum.name: b3

Enum.description: The 2-write sequence has completed. Generate the specified gate reset(s).
